correctness.rationale: The normalized 3D Maxwell radial mixture follows exactly from the source Gaussian variance. Fixed-positive-radius dominated convergence and a hyperbolic substitution give p_1 in Bessel functions. Its strict rise above p_1(0+) and decay to zero imply a separated outer local maximum. A rigorous small-phase rescaling yields local C^2 convergence of p_{1-eps}(sqrt(eps)y) to a Dawson profile. The Dawson ODE and large-argument expansion prove one nondegenerate inner maximum and y*=2.1241137947344..., so it persists and is distinct from the outer local maximum for sufficiently small eps. Strict radial decrease of the full spatial density follows by differentiation of its positive Gaussian mixture. The included verify.py passed the finite integral/Bessel/Dawson and representative peak diagnostics; those computations do not prove infinite statements.
